blindSummary: The dedicated country dossier found no region-specific legal, incident or enforcement finding for this state/province, so its picture rests on the national framework. The 2025 national movement's annual report places this state/province at 2.09% of nationally documented abuse cases - up from 1.32% in 2024 - with a +45.45% year-on-year rise in 2025, the second-largest increase of any region, inside a national pattern where only the two biggest regions fell while the other 14 rose (national total 3,620 cases, +27.1%, a 24-year record). The report reads this decentralisation as documented hate diffusing into territories with less public LGBTIQ+ visibility.
blindSourceSummaries: An international LGBT-rights organisation's overview of this country (updated 12 March 2026): national framework - same-sex marriage and adoption since March 2022; hate-crime law with SOGI aggravation since 2012; civil unions since 2015; self-determination gender-recognition law in force since 2019; third-sex birth designation for intersex children since 2006; no ban on medically unnecessary intersex surgeries on minors but 2023 health-ministry guidance against them; 2025 first conviction for a lesbophobic femicide; societal opinion broadly positive with recent pushback on trans rights after a 2024 parliamentary commission on trans children (final report May 2025). National picture only; no region-specific content.

National LGBTQ news outlet feature (19 March 2025) on a year of regression for LGBTQ rights in this country, used in the dossier's national political-direction note. The cached page body retrieved only site navigation, so this summary rests on the headline and the dossier's citation. No region-specific content.

A national rights movement's 24th annual human-rights report on sexual and gender diversity in this country (2025 facts, published March 2026): national total of 3,620 discrimination cases in 2025, +27.1% and the highest on record (23% of all cases in 24 years); geographic shares - the largest region 46.13%, the second-largest 23.46%, the third 7.2%, and this state/province 2.09%; 2025 movement - the two largest regions fell -17.56% and -14.35% while the other 14 regions rose, with this state/province at +45.45%, which the report reads as hate decentralising toward territories with less public LGBTIQ+ visibility.
